original_outcome: bounded typed actions preserve actor and source basis
decision: Canonical typed current-response candidate and ordered step admission are the executable bounded example; no new public or persisted plan schema is substituted.

candidate_schema.actor: CommandInput.member, independently compared with CandidateOwner.member and current membership/offer
candidate_schema.basis: Basis(session, run, recovery epoch and sequence), observed revision, exact native current CheckpointPins
candidate_schema.source: Current pending window/selected offer RuleReference in the trusted inventory and compiled source registry

compound_step_schema.ordered_inputs: Borrowed [GameInput] with distinct OperationId request identities; OperationId is not a canonical PlanStepId.
compound_step_schema.admission: PlanAdmission.first is the only admitted current response; requires_revalidation is the exact unchanged tail.
compound_step_schema.resumption: Validate against the newly committed current checkpoint and fresh native owner; lookup any retained operation first.

approved_planned_fields.status: Persistent ActionPlan owner/types/executor remain a future production gate; this Design example does not claim these are implemented.

actual_consumer: df-engine::plan_staging::stage_plan_head uses Intent admission then the registered semantic pending path; stages head only, does not commit or authorize tail.

alternatives.decision: Rejected: native actor, operation, basis, sources and compiled mechanics are independent.

alternatives.choice: Predict legality for all future steps or rollback a committed prefix
alternatives.decision: Rejected: revalidation and explicit durable outcomes belong to the current commit owner.

alternatives.choice: Invent PlanStepId from OperationId or a public ActionPlan DTO
alternatives.decision: Rejected: canonical allocation, lifetime and persistence need their existing approved owner.

verification.native: Exact compiled contract binary must execute all 12 tests against source/build closure.
verification.source_fixture: Synthetic current checkpoint/catalog/handler inputs prove boundary semantics, not selected standard-2024 book coverage.
verification.persistence: Current borrowed admission is not a physical durable ActionPlan fixture.
